faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.how_a: Pick the items you want on the Trade page or on an item's page. Our TF2 trade bots check the trade and send you a Steam trade offer within seconds. Accept it in Steam and the trade is done.
faq.limits_a: Currently you can trade a maximum of 10 items on each side. Pure up to 550 keys, 2 keys worth of refs, 27 recs & 18 scraps.
faq.pure_q: Can I trade items for pure?
faq.pure_a_html: Yes, if there is enough pure on the other side of the trade. You can also get mixed (pure & items).
faq.money_a_html: No, we don't support real world money transactions. No balance either!
faq.deposits_a_html: No, we would never ask you to deposit your items.
faq.refunds_a_html: No. All trades are final once confirmed. Always make sure a trade offer includes the right items.
faq.legit_a_html: I'm aware of a scam that used the domain tf2deal.com in the past {link}. I found out after buying the domain, and I liked the name too much to change it. So yes, this tf2deal.com is legit.
faq.owner_a: The site is run by a single person: Nikolas Malík (me). A passionate TF2 player, trader and self-taught web developer based in Czechia (Central Europe).
faq.bot_q: What is a TF2 trade bot?
faq.bot_a: A Steam account run by software that trades Team Fortress 2 items on its own, at any time of day. TF2Deal.com's trade bots are listed on the About page; nobody else trades for the site.
faq.sell_q: How do I sell TF2 items for keys?
faq.sell_a: Sign in with Steam, open the item's page or the Trade page and pick your item. The bots pay in keys and refined metal at the price shown, as long as they are buying that item.

welcome.title: Welcome to TF2Deal!
welcome.intro: Thanks for stopping by! TF2Deal is a TF2 trading site I've been building in my free time since 2020, with one goal: fair, quick trades without waiting for anyone to reply. Our bots are ready whenever you are, so take a look around.

features.items_text: Every item page shows the stock, the price and recent sales.
features.giveaways_text: Join our Steam group and enter the giveaways.
features.safe_text: Every trade is a Steam trade offer you check before accepting. Only the bots on our About page are ours.
features.yours_text: 8 languages, and looks for day, night and every TF2 event, all in the menu.

ks_combos.title: Exact prices for every Professional Killstreak combo
ks_combos.text: Professional Killstreak weapons, Kits and Kit Fabricators now have a Combo select on their page. Pick a sheen and killstreaker to see what that exact combo costs. Combos few traders look for, like Hypno-Beam, are cheaper to buy, and the item's tooltip tells you when a copy is one of them.

key_bank.title: Swap keys and metal with our bank bots
key_bank.text: The new Keys page swaps Mann Co. Supply Crate Keys for refined metal and back, up to 5 keys a trade, at live prices that follow backpack.tf. Pick a bank bot, see how many keys it can buy and sell right now, and get the Steam offer in seconds.

trade_details.title: Latest trades show item details
trade_details.text: Latest trades and your trade history now name every item in its quality colour, the way TF2 writes it, with its unusual effect, sheen, killstreaker, paint, spells and strange parts right under the pictures.

fabricators.title: See what a Kit Fabricator makes
fabricators.text: A Kit Fabricator's picture now shows the Kit it makes in its bottom left corner. In the item details window (right-click an item, or tap its tooltip) you also see the items that fabricator needs and how many of each. Every fabricator needs its own, so fabricators that need different items no longer stack in the trade window.

lamplight.title: A new look: Lamplight
lamplight.text: TF2Deal is warmer now: a winter night in plum, cream text and the amber light of a lit cabin window, with a new logo, new fonts and a new app icon. Everything works as before. If you like another look better, Midnight black, White and Nebula are still in the theme menu.

quality_glow.title: Item quality at a glance
quality_glow.text: Item cards no longer have a coloured bar. An item's quality now glows softly behind its picture and colours its name, the way TF2 shows it: orange for Strange, purple for Unusual, teal for Haunted. Unique items glow the least, so the rarer ones stand out.

nebula.title: New look: Nebula
nebula.text: A deep-space sky of violet, blue and teal gas, with stardust that slowly drifts and twinkles behind the page. Texts and boxes stay easy to read on it, on phones too. Pick it in the theme menu and the site remembers it.

updates_page.title: Every update on one page
updates_page.text: This page lists every feature added to the site, newest first, with the day and time it went live. You'll find it under What's new at the bottom of every page.

themes.title: Two new looks: Midnight and White
themes.text: Midnight black is true black for dark rooms and OLED screens, and White is a bright look for daytime. Both sit next to Night sky and the TF2 event looks, and the site remembers the one you pick.

collections.title: Item collections
collections.text: Item pages now show the collection an item comes from, with every other item in it, highest grade first. War-painted weapons show the collection of their war paint.

killstreak.title: Killstreak items, each on its own
killstreak.text: Killstreak, Specialized Killstreak and Professional Killstreak weapons now have item pages of their own, each with its own price and stock, so you can find exactly the one you want.

item_details.title: Right-click for item details
item_details.text: Right-click an item on the trade page or an item page to see everything about that copy: paint, spells, strange parts, killstreak and links to backpack.tf, the TF2 Wiki and Steam. On a phone, tap the item's tooltip.

giveaway_share.title: Share giveaways with your friends
giveaway_share.text: Every giveaway has its own link now, with a picture of the prize that shows up in Discord, Steam chat and on social sites. Press Share on the giveaway page. A giveaway also needs a minimum number of entries: until enough people are in, it stays open.

today_trades.title: Latest trades: every trade from today
today_trades.text: Latest trades on the home page now lists every trade made today, newest on top, one under the other. Keep pressing Show 5 more to go back through the whole day.
